invention.name: Rootbound Crossing
invention.description: A living, woven vine bridge grows from the near bank to the far bank, unfurling leaves as its solid walking surface extends. Press again and it curls back into its roots.
invention.usage: Press F to grow the bridge along the marked crossing. Wait until it reaches the far bank, then walk across. Press F again to retract; press during growth to ...
limitations: Growth takes about three seconds; unfinished vines do not support the gap ahead.
Retraction removes support from the far end first. Get onto a bank before retracting.
The leafy deck has no guardrails.
